in_urdu.name: حیا
in_urdu.meaning: حیا کا مطلب ہے شرم و حیا، تواضع، اللہ سے حیا کرنا

in_english.name: Hayaa
in_english.meaning: Hayaa means modesty, shyness, and humility before God
in_english.long_meaning: Hayaa is an Arabic feminine name that means modesty, shyness, and humility before God. It is one of the names mentioned in the Quran and reflects good qualities and moral virtues. The name Hayaa signifies a person with a humble and reserved personality who respects themselves and others. Etymologically, it is derived from the Arabic root 'H-Y-Y' which connotes the idea of modesty and humility. Historically, the name has been used in Islamic tradition to denote a person with high moral character and spiritual significance
